findings.title: CagriSema in adults with T2D inadequately controlled on diet and exercise (REIMAGINE 1): phase 3a (Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol)
findings.whatChanged: Dossier covers the REDEFINE obesity programme only; the entire REIMAGINE type 2 diabetes programme is now published and absent from the dossier. n=189, 40 weeks. DOI 10.1016/S2213-8587(26)00126-9, NCT06323174.

findings.title: CagriSema versus semaglutide or cagrilintide in people with T2D (REIMAGINE 2): phase 3 (Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol)
findings.whatChanged: First head-to-head of CagriSema vs its own two components in T2D, 30 countries, 68 weeks. Dossier has no head-to-head component comparison. DOI 10.1016/S2213-8587(26)00125-7, NCT06065540.

findings.title: CagriSema as an add-on to basal insulin in adults with T2D (REIMAGINE 3): phase 3 (Lancet)
findings.whatChanged: Add-on-to-basal-insulin indication entirely absent from the dossier. n=274, 40 weeks, 6 countries. DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(26)01022-6, NCT06323161.

findings.title: Phase 2 CagriSema/cagrilintide study — WITHDRAWN
findings.whatChanged: Status changed to WITHDRAWN, whyStopped "The study is withdrawn due to strategic reasons." Dossier trial tracking does not reflect any withdrawal.

findings.title: Phase 3 CagriSema/cagrilintide study — WITHDRAWN
findings.whatChanged: Status changed to WITHDRAWN, whyStopped "The study is withdrawn due to strategic reasons." A withdrawn phase 3 is material to a pipeline dossier.
